Hi Jason — thanks for the upload and for flagging the invoice formatting. A few items from Procurement (see inline):

1) PO/Reference: We will assign an official Redwood PO number for the first invoice. Procurement will issue PO: RED-2026-7842. Please add that exact reference to the invoice header and any payment remittances.

2) Spend cap: For the initial onboarding month we're placing a provisional spend cap of $40,000 while we validate usage patterns. If you expect to exceed that in month 1 please flag now so we can request an uplift from Finance.

3) Line items / SKU breakdown: We require SKU-level line items for matching to our GL (unit price & qty). The consolidated single-line draft will cause reconciliation delays. Please resubmit an itemized XLS and include SKU codes that match your catalog. See attached template recommendation: Vertex_PO_LineItems_v2.xlsx (I've copied procurement column headers in the spreadsheet).

4) Timeline: If you can send the revised line-item sheet and the invoice with RED-2026-7842 by EOD Monday (20 Jul), Accounts Payable can process on the July run.

I copied Marissa from Accounting to help with matching and payment timing.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Procurement | Redwood Inference
